bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (URL sharing), springboard/ui/src/detect.rs (link detection), springboard/apps/news-desktop/src/pictures.rs (og:image scrape, app-local)
summary: Apple's framework fetches a URL's title, icon, image and video and draws a rich link view. BifrOSt has no SDK API for URL metadata or a rich link view. It can detect URLs in text and share them through the share sheet, and the News app scrapes og:image for its own pictures, but none of that is exposed to apps as link presentation.

features.bifrost: none in springboard/sdk/src/ (no metadata fetch API); page fetch exists only for the browser in springboard/src/shell/browser/fetch.rs
features.note: no SDK call returns a title, icon or image for an arbitrary URL; timeout and subresource options have no counterpart
no placeholder or metadata-driven link card in the shared kit

features.feature: Representative title, icon and image of a URL
features.note: News scrapes the og:image meta tag for its own article pictures; the logic is app-local and not an SDK API, and there is no icon lookup

features.feature: Sharing a URL with metadata to the share sheet
features.apple: LPLinkMetadata used as an activity item (share sheet rich preview)
features.note: a URL is shared as plain text or URL; the picker shows no rich preview of the link

features.apple: share sheet and open-URL handoff (LPLinkMetadata for display)
features.note: a shared URL arrives as Input::Open(url); the app gets no metadata with it

features.apple: not part of LinkPresentation; the link presentation starts from a URL
features.note: a data detector finds http, https and www links in plain text; it does not feed a link view
depends on the fetch API, which does not exist; the browser error page in springboard/src/shell/browser/fetch.rs is HTML, not a typed error

gaps: No SDK API that fetches a URL's title, icon, image and video (LPMetadataProvider equivalent), with a timeout and cancel
No rich link view widget (LPLinkView equivalent) in the shared kit, with placeholder and metadata modes
The News app's og:image scrape (springboard/apps/news-desktop/src/pictures.rs) is app-local and not reusable by other apps
The share sheet sends URLs as plain items and does not show a rich link preview
No typed error model for link fetches (LPError equivalent)
